introHtml:
Marketing directors and HR managers looking to reduce digital eye strain among employees will find custom blue light computer glasses a practical, wellness-focused giveaway. These glasses filter harmful blue light from screens, helping to minimize headaches and fatigue during long work hours. Perfect for corporate wellness programs, trade shows, or employee onboarding kits, they offer a functional way to keep your brand top-of-mind while promoting eye health.

Our selection includes unisex frames in various styles and colors, all designed to block blue light without affecting color perception. Each pair can be customized with your logo through screen printing or laser engraving on the temple. With durable construction and lightweight materials, these glasses are comfortable for all-day wear. Whether you need 50 pairs for a small team or 5,000 for a large event, we offer competitive bulk pricing and fast turnaround.
buyingGuideHtml:
When ordering custom blue light computer glasses, focus on lens quality and frame durability. Look for lenses that block at least 90% of blue light in the 400–450nm range. Polycarbonate lenses are lightweight and impact-resistant, ideal for daily use. Frames made from TR-90 or acetate offer flexibility and long-lasting wear. Avoid cheap plastic frames that may break easily, especially if you're ordering for a safety-conscious environment.

Materials and Build Quality

Most promotional blue light glasses use polycarbonate lenses for their shatter resistance and clarity. Frames come in plastic, metal, or TR-90. Plastic frames are affordable and come in many colors. Metal frames offer a professional look. TR-90 is a high-end nylon that is both flexible and durable. For safety managers, consider glasses with spring hinges to prevent breakage during active use.

Common Use Cases

Marketing directors often use branded blue light glasses as trade show giveaways or client appreciation gifts. HR directors include them in employee wellness kits or remote worker welcome packages. Safety managers might consider them for office safety programs, as they reduce eye strain and improve focus. Business owners find them effective for corporate events and promotional campaigns targeting tech-savvy audiences.

Decoration Options

The most common customization methods for blue light glasses are screen printing and laser engraving on the temple. Screen printing works well for logos with fine details and multiple colors. Laser engraving offers a permanent, scratch-resistant mark. For a premium look, consider debossing on the frame. Full-color heat transfer is also available for complex designs. Ensure the decoration area is large enough for your logo.

Quantity and MOQ Guidance

Minimum order quantities for custom blue light glasses typically start at 50–100 units. As order size increases, unit price drops significantly. For example, ordering 500 pairs can reduce cost per pair by 30–40% compared to 100 pairs. If you're planning a large event, consider sizing up to get the best value. Wholesale pricing is available for orders of 1,000+ pairs. Always order a few extra to account for defects or last-minute needs.

Avoiding Common Mistakes

One common mistake is not checking the lens coating. Ensure the glasses block blue light without a yellow tint, which can distort colors. Another pitfall is ordering the wrong frame size. Offer a unisex size that fits most adults, or provide multiple sizes. Also, consider the lead time: custom orders typically take 2–3 weeks. Plan ahead to avoid rush fees. Finally, test a sample before placing a large bulk order to verify quality and fit.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom blue light glasses?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities typically start at 50 to 100 units, depending on the frame style and customization method. Larger orders reduce the per-unit cost. Contact us for specific MOQs on your chosen model.

faqs.q: How are logos applied to blue light glasses?
faqs.a: Logos are applied via screen printing or laser engraving on the temple. Screen printing allows for multiple colors, while laser engraving is permanent and scratch-resistant. We can also do full-color heat transfer for complex designs.

faqs.q: What is the typical production lead time?
faqs.a: Standard lead time is 2-3 weeks from artwork approval. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. We recommend ordering at least 3 weeks before your event or distribution date.

faqs.q: Can I order a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer sample orders. You can request a single pair with your logo to verify quality, fit, and lens performance. Sample pricing applies, and the cost is often credited toward a larger order.

faqs.q: Are these glasses suitable for all-day computer use?
faqs.a: Yes, our blue light glasses are designed for extended screen time. They block harmful blue light without distorting colors, reducing eye strain and fatigue. Frames are lightweight and comfortable for all-day wear.
